title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-18
lineage: SBD > MR > Reel > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with a crummy audience first set but stellar soundboard later, featuring a monster "Other One" and standout jams like Good Lovin' and St. Stephen.
ai_review.review: The show shines thanks to an inspired setlist and high‑energy performances – the extended Other One, a 21‑minute Good Lovin', and a ripping St Stephen > Not Fade Away are repeatedly praised. Recording quality is mixed: the early audience‑sourced portion sounds muddy, but once the soundboard kicks in (Me & My Uncle onward) the mix becomes crisp and the band’s nuances come through clearly.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance highlighted by several reviewers outweighs the initial recording flaws; the later soundboard segment is excellent, leading to an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First set captured from audience mic – muddy and crummy. Soundboard feed starts around "Me & My Uncle" delivering crisp, clear mix with Phil's bass loud and Jerry’s guitar prominent.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic first half despite recording issues, followed by a superb second half where the band locks into long jams and tight playing; song selection praised as outstanding.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers rave about Jerry’s unleashed solo work – especially his opening St. Stephen tease and the powerful "Other One" jam.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass comes through loud and clear on the soundboard portion, noted as a highlight of the early 1970 recordings.
